title: What It Actually Looks Like to Forgive Him and Still Keep Your Distance
caption:
Forgiving him doesn't mean trusting him.

A lot of men think forgiveness means going back to the way it was. It doesn't. You can let go of the debt and still keep a boundary. Forgiveness is free. Trust is earned back. Joseph forgave his brothers and still tested them first.

Pray for him by name this week, and keep your distance without keeping score.

Send this to a brother who needs it.
